summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K, which is a periodic report of a foreign private issuer, containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. This is a routine earnings update, not a special situation event. The filing includes financial data, segment information, and changes in equity under IFRS. There is no mention of any mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The report is purely financial in nature, with no corporate actions requiring classification as a special situation.
